[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested three layout ideas:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Layout 1: Conversational Circle - sectional sofa along the longer wall with windows, armchairs facing the sofa, side tables between the armchairs and sofa, TV stand on a shorter wall, bookshelf on the remaining shorter wall.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Layout 2: Cozy Nook - sectional sofa in a corner, one armchair in the opposite corner, coffee table in front of the sofa, side tables placed accordingly, TV stand on the longer wall, bookshelf on the remaining shorter wall.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Layout 3: Symmetrical Balance - sectional sofa in the center of the longer wall, armchairs on either side of the coffee table, side tables on either side of the armchairs, TV stand on one shorter wall, bookshelf on the other shorter wall.  
[PREFERENCE] User liked the conversational circle layout idea.
